item.title: Two Kashmir residents held for espionage activities in Arunachal
item.description: Itanagar: The Itanagar Police has arrested two persons from Jammu and Kashmir for alleged espionage activities in Arunachal Pradesh, an officer said on Tuesday. Inspector General of Police (Law and Order) Chukhu Apa said the two persons were arrested from Kupwara district of Jammu and Kashmir on December 18, and they have been brought to the state, where they are currently in police custody. item.title: Srinagar Accident leaves Motorcyclist critically injured
item.description: Srinagar, Dec 25: A motorcyclist was critically injured in a road accident in Hyderpora area of Srinagar on Thursday after his motorcycle was struck by an unknown vehicle, officials said. Officials stated that the injured sustained multiple injuries and was immediately rushed to SMHS Hospital, Srinagar, where his condition remains critical.
